benchmark.source_contract: unchanged original allocation/fill/transform/checksum/release fixtures; checked HIA sums; reference sums agree on the registered finite domain
benchmark.ordering: rotate kernels by group; rotate backends by group plus original kernel index; reverse odd groups
benchmark.pgo: actual Clang instrumentation, training split only, profile merge, profile-use rebuild
benchmark.candidate_admission: independent compiler proof/certificate required before the candidate artifact is eligible; performance is not a proof of equivalence
benchmark.quality_policy: all registered samples retained; missing/failed/changed-identity observations fail quality; no rerun-to-pass
benchmark.toolchain: restored Clang/LLD/profdata identities recorded in the execution plan; Rust 1.95.0, not the earlier 1.90.0 run

upgrade.role: separate secondary two-file interface migration pilot; does not replace or inflate the primary four-task gate
upgrade.models: the same two frozen model families, in the same execution order as the primary experiment
upgrade.context: complete original provider and consumer files, target interface, three public smoke cases; identical task semantics in both languages
upgrade.response: strict JSON files mapping with both complete replacements; actual patch.v2 interface_policy=migrate for HIA, actual api.rs/client.rs compilation for Rust
upgrade.grammar: JSON object syntax only; no answer-specific decoder constraint
upgrade.repair_feedback: compiler or Core-verification diagnostic plus three public smoke cases only; unchanged token budget on the second submission
upgrade.hidden_validation: once after the first public-pass candidate; hidden failures never create a second submission or reach the model
upgrade.hidden_generation: fixed boundary cross-products plus 64 deterministic LCG triples per task, seed 539365416, duplicate and public cases removed
upgrade.native_controls: old and fully upgraded programs execute against the independent oracle; provider-only and consumer-only migrations must fail actual verification or compilation
upgrade.execution_envelope: pure scalar functions; sealed memfd native executable; CPU 2 seconds, address space 256 MiB, wall timeout 5 seconds per validation
upgrade.failure_policy: retain every raw response and failure; no human output rewriting or added attempts
upgrade.scope: two finite interface changes; no general project upgrade productivity, external-caller or human-labor claim

agent.task_origin: same four existing two-helper arithmetic maintenance tasks; model-capacity follow-up, not four new application task families
agent.grammar: JSON object syntax only; no task-specific fields or correct replacements in the decoder
agent.primary_gate_per_model: complete usage and all 4 HIA-query tasks correct; HIA-query successes >= Rust-query successes; total HIA-query input+output tokens <= Rust-query tokens
agent.secondary_gate_per_model: complete usage and all 4 HIA-query tasks correct; HIA-query successes >= HIA-full successes; total HIA-query input+output tokens < HIA-full tokens
agent.cross_family_gate: both frozen independent families must satisfy their gate; no family substitution after seeing answers
agent.failure_policy: retain all requests, responses, rejections, wrong repairs, incomplete cells and infrastructure failures; do not repair model output by hand
agent.scope: finite descriptive evidence; four tasks cannot establish population productivity or total economic cost

models.provenance: official publicly available Qwen GGUF; file hash from pinned repository LFS metadata
